newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Mibtel and Mib30 indicies hit new records.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Mibtel and Mib30 indicies hit new records.

text.p: Italy's all-share Mibtel and the blue-chip Mib30 stock indices both hit new record highs in early Milan bourse trading following the overnight surge in Wall Street, dealers said.

The Milan bourse Mibtel index hit a new record high of 15,307 and was last quoted up 2.54 percent at the high of 15,307, while the Mib30 hit a record of 23,375 and was last quoted up 2.9 percent at 23,359.
